title: The non-inflammatory effect of neuronal NLRP3 on spatial memory after traumatic brain injury
title_zh: 神经元NLRP3在创伤性脑损伤后对空间记忆的非炎症效应
abstract: Abstract The NLRP3 inflammasome has emerged as a critical regulator in neuroinflammatory responses to various brain insults from traumatic, ischemic and neurodegenerative conditions, an effect almost exclusively attributed to microglial NLRP3. Here, we demonstrated that in the absence of changes in inflammatory factors IL-18, IL-1β and TNF-α, neuronal Nlrp3 knockout in hippocampus (nNlrp3 -/- ) improved long-term spatial memory performance, with increased synaptic proteins levels and enhanced amplitude of long-term potentiation at 4 weeks after traumatic brain injury (TBI), compared to wildtype littermates. Notably, the nNlrp3 -/- mice out-performed microglia-specific knockout and global Nlrp3 knockout mice in cognition and synaptic function. We further identified that NLRP3 structurally and functionally directly interacted with the R1 subunit of N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NR1) in hippocampus after TBI. Accordingly, pharmacological inhibition of NLRP3 by MCC950 rescued the decrease in the NMDAR-gated calcium influx by LPS-stimulated hippocampal neurons while selective Nlrp3 knockout in hippocampal neurons partially reversed the decreased phosphorylation level of NR1 after TBI. Collectively, this study provides the first evidence that neuronal NLRP3 constitutes a non-inflammatory response to control synaptic plasticity and cognitive function via NR1-dependent non-inflammatory mechanism in TBI and thus broadens the central role of NLRP3 in neuronal adaptive mechanisms to include both microglial NLRP3-inflammation arm and the neuronal NLRP3-synaptic plasticity arm.
abstract_zh: 摘要：NLRP3炎症小体已成为多种脑损伤（创伤性、缺血性和神经退行性疾病）神经炎症反应的关键调节因子，其作用几乎完全归因于小胶质细胞NLRP3。本研究表明，在炎症因子IL-18、IL-1β和TNF-α水平未改变的情况下，海马区神经元Nlrp3敲除（nNlrp3 -/-）可在创伤性脑损伤（TBI）后4周显著改善长期空间记忆表现，伴随突触蛋白水平升高和长期增强（LTP）幅度增强。值得注意的是，nNlrp3 -/-小鼠在认知和突触功能上优于小胶质细胞特异性敲除和全局Nlrp3敲除小鼠。进一步研究发现，TBI后NLRP3在结构和功能上直接与海马区N‑甲基‑D‑天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）R1亚基相互作用。相应地，使用MCC950抑制NLRP3可恢复LPS刺激下海马神经元的NMDAR介导钙离子流入的下降，而选择性敲除海马神经元中的Nlrp3则部分逆转TBI后NR1磷酸化水平下降。综上所述，本研究首次提供证据表明神经元NLRP3通过NR1依赖的非炎症机制在TBI中调控突触可塑性和认知功能，扩展了NLRP3在神经元适应机制中的中心作用，包括小胶质细胞NLRP3炎症支和神经元NLRP3突触可塑性支。
